audit_limitations: Doxorubicin integer-labelled20–50 and51–86 bands leave continuous-value gap50<bilirubin<51; use explicit review/rounding-policy confirmation. No AST reduction is printed in this updated table.
CrCl10–29 and>=30 integer-labelled bands leave29<CrCl<30 undefined for continuous values; confirm clinical rounding/band interpretation instead of silently treating as normal.

Paclitaxel bilirubin bands leave1.25<ratio<1.26 and2<ratio<2.01 gaps. Both ALT and bilirubin are needed for a numerical hepatic dose; either high exclusion alone remains actionable. Missing ALT must not infer ALT<10.
Educational / software source reconciliation is not consultant, pharmacy or clinical-use authorisation.
audited_eligibility: HER2 status confirmed with an accurate validated assay

source_monitoring.blood_repeat: FBC/renal/liver profile listed as regular tests; exact frequency not quantified in PDF
source_monitoring.baseline_echo: MUGA/ECHO if age>65years or clinically indicated; LVEF>50% for doxorubicin
source_monitoring.repeat_echo: MUGA/ECHO every12weeks; if cardiac impairment signs, checks every4–8weeks may be more appropriate
source_monitoring.disease_monitoring: Treatment-plan/consultant-directed; no fixed CT/marker schedule stated
source_monitoring.echo_cycle_mapping: Illustrative elapsed-time mapping only:12weeks corresponds to12 weekly trastuzumab intervals (next weekly dose13),4 q21d intervals (next q21d dose5),or6 q14d intervals. If trastuzumab starts at overallcycle5, count from documented baseline/pre-HER2 checkpoint; never reset the due date silently at phase transition.

metadata.schedule_summary: Four AC cycles 21 days apart, then 12 weekly paclitaxel doses with weekly trastuzumab. Continue trastuzumab to complete one year total, without overlapping it with AC.
metadata.dose_level_context: Paclitaxel source reduction ladder 80 / 65 / 50 mg/m². The toxicity-specific action determines whether it applies; neuropathy and hepatic instructions differ.

output_templates.proceed: No encoded action was triggered by the supplied values. Unassessed domains and the full prescribing review remain outstanding.

output_templates.consultant_review: Review the component-specific findings and source uncertainty before treatment.

output_templates.dose_reduce: A component-specific dose modification applies; verify the original and current doses before prescribing.
